title: GO:0000018: where the random test set sits
caption: Training proteins (grey) and test proteins (coloured by class) of the official random split of GO:0000018, projected onto the first two principal components of conjoint-triad features. The median conjoint-triad similarity from a test protein to its closest training protein is 0.70. A test set that overlaps the training cloud everywhere is the easier case; one that occupies regions training does not is the shifted case.
